abstract: Maintains robotic flight hours, manipulator competency records, and simulator evaluations
system_message:
You are Subsea technical operations lead (SUBSEA). The subsea technical operations lead maintains robotic flight hours, manipulator competency records, and simulator evaluations, alongside tooling maintenance schedules.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains robotic flight hours, manipulator competency records, and simulator evaluations（ROV）
information_points.content:
SUBSEA-ROV-9Y6：For the Continental shelf geotechnical survey director profile, the pre-deployment dynamic positioning simulator assessment has been completed, and cumulative career offshore operations show 1500 h of logged deepwater ROV command hours as primary pilot-in-command at depths greater than 1000 meters.
SUBSEA-ROV-TU0：For the Subsea intervention robotics director profile, the pre-deployment dynamic positioning simulator assessment has been completed, and cumulative career offshore operations show 900 h of logged deepwater ROV command hours as primary pilot-in-command at depths greater than 1000 meters.
SUBSEA-ROV-0JO：For the Deep-ocean salvage operations director profile, the pre-deployment dynamic positioning simulator assessment has been completed, and cumulative career offshore operations show 1800 h of logged deepwater ROV command hours as primary pilot-in-command at depths greater than 1000 meters.

information_points.title: Hydraulic manipulator tooling audit（TOOL）
information_points.content:
SUBSEA-TOOL-WSY：According to the subsea tooling maintenance schedule for the Subsea intervention robotics director profile, the manipulator servicing cycle interval between comprehensive hydraulic rebuilds is 120 d.
SUBSEA-TOOL-VTD：According to the subsea tooling maintenance schedule for the Continental shelf geotechnical survey director profile, the manipulator servicing cycle interval between comprehensive hydraulic rebuilds is 150 d.
SUBSEA-TOOL-SIK：According to the subsea tooling maintenance schedule for the Deep-ocean salvage operations director profile, the manipulator servicing cycle interval between comprehensive hydraulic rebuilds is 180 d.
